evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection.
